title: Lead Response Score™
tagline: How many leads are you losing to slow follow-up? Get your score and estimated lost revenue.
description: 12 questions about how your business handles new leads — speed, follow-up, CRM and automation — plus an estimate of the revenue slipping away.

categories.label: Response Speed
categories.recommendation: Aim for a first response within 5 minutes: an instant automated reply plus a notification that gets a human following up the same hour. Speed is the single biggest lever in lead conversion.

categories.label: Follow-Up Persistence
categories.recommendation: Build an automated 5-touch follow-up sequence over 14 days (email + SMS). Most sales happen after the 3rd contact — most businesses stop after 1.

categories.label: CRM & Tracking
categories.recommendation: Put every lead into one CRM with a stage and a next action. If a lead isn't in the system, it doesn't exist — and it can't be followed up.

categories.label: Channels & Automation
categories.recommendation: Add SMS to your follow-up mix (98% open rates) and automate booking so hot leads can schedule themselves the moment they're interested.

metrics.label: Leads at risk per year
metrics.description: Leads likely lost yearly to slow response and weak follow-up, based on your score.

metrics.label: Estimated revenue lost per year
metrics.description: Assumes a conservative 25% of those at-risk leads would have converted with fast, persistent follow-up.

bands.label: Leaking Leads Daily
bands.summary: Leads are contacting your business — and then buying from whoever answers first. Research consistently shows responding within 5 minutes multiplies conversion many times over; right now, speed and follow-up gaps are actively funding your competitors. This is the most profitable fix available to you.
actionPlan: Week 1: Set up an instant auto-reply (email + SMS if possible) for every new lead, 24/7.
Week 1: Add missed-call text-back so phone leads never go cold.
Week 2: Put every lead into one CRM — inbox-as-CRM ends now.
Week 2: Add your booking link to every automated reply.
Week 3: Build a 5-touch automated follow-up sequence over 14 days.
Week 3: Add automated reminders on every quote you send.
Week 4: Review: response time, follow-ups sent, leads booked.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to wire the whole pipeline together properly.

bands.label: Losing Winnable Deals
bands.summary: You respond to leads — but not fast enough, and not persistently enough. The calculated revenue above is what that gap likely costs you. The good news: you have the pieces; they just need automation and consistency.
actionPlan: Week 1: Cut first-response time to under 5 minutes with automation + notifications.
Week 1: Fix your weakest category from the breakdown below.
Week 2: Extend follow-up to 5+ touches — automated, so persistence is guaranteed.
Week 2: Add SMS to at least two steps of your sequence.
Week 3: Build a long-term nurture list for 'not right now' leads.
Week 3: Start tracking lead-to-customer conversion in your CRM.
Week 4: Compare this month's booked calls to last month's.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to add AI qualification and smart routing.

bands.label: Fast & Persistent — Now optimize
bands.summary: Your lead handling beats the vast majority of small businesses — fast, tracked and persistent. From here, gains come from optimization: better qualification, smarter personalization and squeezing more conversion from the same lead flow.
actionPlan: Week 1: Audit your sequence content — personalize by lead source or service interest.
Week 1: Verify every channel (form, phone, social, chat) feeds the CRM.
Week 2: Add AI lead qualification so your time goes to the hottest prospects.
Week 2: A/B test your first-response message.
Week 3: Build win-back automation for old closed-lost leads.
Week 3: Review conversion by source — shift budget to what converts.
Week 4: Document the whole system so it survives staff changes.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to explore AI voice/chat answering for 24/7 coverage.
